Tasks
The host plays in another language: task texts come in his.
Step away from that body. I killed him, it's mine.
I won't say it twice: leave my kill alone.
Touch his stuff and you will regret it.
Back off, stranger. I got him first.
Hands off, or I open fire.
You found nothing useful on this body.
Take it, friend. I don't mind.
It's yours. We are on the same side.
Go ahead, help yourself.
My kill. Pay me %d RU and take it: press USE again within %d seconds.
Pleasure doing business. Take what you need.
You don't have %d RU. Come back with the money.
This NPC has given the group all the tasks it can. Turn one of them in.
The task was not given: the host ran into an error while starting it. Try taking it again.

While you were away the group joined the %s faction.
The faction is changed by the whole group at once: this is done at the faction's leader.
Mind this: all your comrades come over with you, those who are not around now as well. There is no way back. Decide.
The job is done. I ask for the last time: you and all your comrades, those who are away too, come over to us. Are you sure?
Yes. We are with you.
I need to think it over.
%s joined the %s faction.
The Voice of the Monolith
The unbelievers have silenced the Brain Scorcher. The Monolith demands its voice back. Go to lab X10 and switch the installation on again.
The Scorcher is silent. What is the will of the Monolith?
The unbelievers reached the heart of X10 and silenced the Shield. The Monolith does not forgive silence. Go down there. Give the Scorcher back its voice.
The Monolith guides me. I go.
Not now.
Go. The Monolith sees you.
The switch does not give. The installation has not settled yet.
The switch is jammed for good. It will not move again.
